content: If you are like me and had to do all the calibration from the menu instead of the wizard you don't need to do input shaping or phase stepping since that is only for the models with accelerometers. Input shaping was basically handled when you did the belt tuning.

replies.content:
This is the INDX upgrade guide, and INDX has a built in accelerometer.
So you really should do the input shaping and phase stepping.
